# LikelihoodInformedSubspace { #deep_tensor.LikelihoodInformedSubspace }

```python
LikelihoodInformedSubspace(
    dim: int,
    num_comp: int = 0,
    fixed_comp: bool = True,
    update_method: str = 'augment',
    num_samples_gram: int = 100,
    eps: float = 0.01,
    initial_basis: Tensor | None = None,
    device: torch.device = torch.get_default_device(),
)
```

A likelihood-informed subspace.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**num_comp**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The number of samples from the complement subspace to use when  evaluating the profile function.

<code>[**fixed_comp**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Whether to fix the samples from the complement subspace.

<code>[**update_method**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'augment\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   How to update the subspace. This can be `'rebuild'` (construct  a new subspace from scratch at each DIRT layer), or `'augment'`  (retain the previously-constructed subspace at each DIRT layer,  and potentially add new components).

<code>[**num_samples_gram**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [100]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The number of samples to use to construct a Monte Carlo  estimate of the Gram matrix.

<code>[**eps**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.01]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The tolerance, $\epsilon$, used to select the dimension of the  subspace. The dimension of the subspace is the smallest $r$  such that  $$     \frac{1}{2}\left(\sum_{k=r+1}^{d}\lambda_{k}\right)^{1/2}          \leq \epsilon, $$ where $\{\lambda_{k}\}_{k=1}^{n}$ denote the eigenvalues of the  current Gram matrix ordered from largest to smallest.

<code>[**initial_basis**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   A set of basis vectors to initialise the subspace with.

<code>[**device**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [torch.device]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [torch.get_default_device()]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The device to carry out computations on.
